IMG_0702,"Yaowarat Chinatown Heritage Center","EN+KO+TR+VI","2024","12","27","2024-12-27",13.7377861111111,100.513733333333,"Rice Gruel Shop
The Chinese lived mainly on rice gruel. With the growing numbers
of Chinese immigrants seeking jobs in Thailand, more rice gruel shops
emerged. They were the places where Chinese earning low wages could
enjoy a heavy, hearty rice-intensive meal with only a couple of small-sized,
simple. Inexpensive dishes. Such a shop could be found either in a
peddied style or stationary in a shack. This type of shop was known later
as ‘poor man’s rice gruel shop’ and became quite popular.

Rice Trade: A New Road to Prosperity
After the Bowring Treaty between Thalland and Great Britain In 1855, Thal government
allowed an uncontrolled export of rice for the first time. It was not long before Thailand topped
the list as world’s No.1 rice exporter. Rice trade becomes the enterprise that generates an
enormous size of revenue. Located along Chao Phraya River were large numbers of rice milis.
At the Initial stage, these and all rice exporting enterprises were owned by westerners, with
Chinese staff acting as “compradore” or thelr representatives In dealing with rice farmers and
gcquiúng paddy for the mills.
it took the Chinese hardly two decades before they knew all the Ins and outs of the
business to be able fo run the first rice mills of thelr own In 1879. Before long, thelr rice
enterprises could be expanded widely within the Chinese community. Well-versed merchants
who became wealthy as authorized tax collectors got Involved In an Intensive Jolnt-venture
investment and fostering a close connection with the new generation of Chinese merchants
who owned thriving business In the rice market In Swatow, Hong Kong and Singapore, which
were compulsory If they were to successfully compete with western businessmen, As 11 turned
out, the Chinese managed to have an Integrated control on Thailand's rice trade components
ranging from buying paddy from rice farmers to milling and exporting.

due to lack of knowledge and experience as well as Inadequate operating capital to compete

lesson for the younger. In the end, It was Chinese businessmen who have since the end of

IMG_1084,"Memory July 15 Museum","TR","2026","05","24","2026-05-24",41.0373194444444,29.041875,"In the old Turkey, the hostile attitude toward religious values and devout people
prevented people from freely
practicing their religion. In the 1970s, Fethullah Gülen and his associates,
taking advantage of this situation in Turkey and exploiting
people’s religious sentiments, began opening the first institutions
of the Fethullahist Terrorist Organization (FETO).
FETÖ is an organization characterized by a rigid hierarchy, where members
prefer to speak in code and exchange secret messages. Members of this terrorist
organization began infiltrating intelligence agencies, law enforcement, the judiciary, and military structures
through covert means. Once they believed they were sufficiently
organized within any given institution, they then openly
targeted other employees who were not part of their group.
In doing so, they employed unjust and unlawful methods such as
blackmail tapes, slander, and the theft of exam questions.
FETÖ, which appeared to the outside world and to Turkey’s devout people as benevolent,
moderate, and helpful, concealed itself for many years
behind this facade. Although the organization operated under a religious guise, its so-called religious activities
did not go beyond having people listen to Fethullah Gülen’s speeches, read his books, and
build a cult of personality around him. FETÖ, which brainwashed its members through various
methods, eventually began implying to them that
Fethullah Gülen was the Mahdi and openly stated this to those
it had appointed to administrative positions.
FETÖ applied the tactic it used in every institution—infiltrating and,
once it had secured a certain majority, declaring war on those who were not part of it—
most recently against the state. Believing it had achieved a sufficient majority
after organizing itself at various levels of the state, FETÖ
declared war on the AK Party government and the state
during the process that began on December 17–25. Having suffered defeat in every arena in this war, FETÖ,
realizing it had been cornered before July 15, 2016, this time attempted
a coup with its members within the military. The night of July 15, 2016,
went down in history as FETÖ’s bloodiest act.
FETÖ is a terrorist organization that employs psychological warfare
techniques and places heavy emphasis on intelligence and
lobbying activities both domestically and abroad. Acting in concert with other terrorist organizations it uses as proxies,
it has carried out and orchestrated both violent and psychological warfare
operations. FETÖ leader Fetullah Gülen currently
resides in the state of Pennsylvania in the United States

column2: ,",Eski Türkiye'de dini değerlere ve mütedeyyin insanlara karşı e

column1: var olan düşmanca tutum, insanların dini yaşamlarını özgürce o
yaşamasına engel oluyordu. 1970'li yıllarda Türkiye'nin bu o
durumundan yararlanıp insanların dini duygularını istismar eden
Fetullah Gülen ve etrafındakiler, Fetullahçı Terör Örgütü'nün o
(FETS) ilk kurumlarını açmaya başladılar.
FETÖ, katı bir hiyerarşinin olduğu, üyelerinin şifreli konuşmayı
ve gizli mesajlar vermeyi tercih ettiği bir yapılanmadır. Bu terör
örgütü üyeleri istihbarata, emniyete, yargı ve askeri yapılanmalara
gizli yollarla sızmaya başladılar. Herhangi bir kurumda yeterince
örgütlendiklerini düşündüklerinde ise bu sefer açıktan
kendilerinden olmayan diğer kurum çalışanlarını hedef aldılar.
Bu yolda şantaj kasetleri, iftiralar, sınav sorularının çalınması gibi
haksız ve hukuksuz yöntemleri kullandılar.
Dış dünyaya ve Türkiye'nin mütedeyyin insanlarına iyilik sever,
ılımlı ve yardımcı görünen FETÖ bu kisvesiyle uzun yıllar kendini
gizledi. Örgüt; dini kisve ile hareket etse de dini faaliyet adı altında
Fetullah Gülen'in konuşmalarını dinletmek, kitaplarını okutmak ve
bir kişilik kültü inşa etmekten ileri gitmedi. Örgüt üyelerinin çeşitli
yöntemlerle beynini yıkayan FETÖ belli bir süre sonra üyelerine
Fethullah Gülen'in mehdi olduğu imalarını yapmaya ve idari
görevlere getirdiği kişilere de bunu açıktan söylemeye başladı.
FETÖ her kurumda uyguladığı, sızıp belirli bir çoğunluğu
yakaladıktan sonra, kendisinden olmayanlara savaş açma taktiğini
en son devlete karşı uyguladı. Devletin farklı kademelerinde
örgütlendikten sonra yeterli çoğunluğa ulaştığını düşünen FETÖ,
17-25 Aralık ile başlayan süreçte, AK Parti hükümetine ve devlete
karşı savaş açtı. Bu savaşta her alanda yenilgiye uğrayan FETÖ,
15 Temmuz 2016 öncesi köşeye sıkıştığını anlayınca bu kez asker
içerisindeki mensubları ile darbe yapmaya kalkıştı. Silahsız
vatandaşlara otomatik silahlarla, tanklarla ve uçaklarla saldırıldığı
15 Temmuz gecesi, FETÖ'nün en kanlı eylemi olarak tarihe geçti.
FETÖ psikolojik savaş tekniklerini kullanarak, istihbarat ve
lobicilik faaliyetlerine yurtiçi ve yurtdışında ağırlık veren bir terör
örgütüdür. Maşa olarak kullandığı diğer terör örgütleriyle birlikte
hareket ederek, gerek şiddet ve gerekse psikolojik savaş eylemleri
yapmış ve yaptırmıştır. FETÖ elebaşısı Fetullah Gülen halen
Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nin Pensilvanya eyaletinde ikamet
etmektedir.

Before the 1960s many women in ethnic minority communities
gave birth at home in the yard or under a temporary shelter in the
forest depending on the ethnic group. Traditionally women gave
birth in standing, squatting or kneeling positions. To facilitate
childbirth the Viet drink sesame seed soup. When a problem arises
for a pregnant Hmong or Yao woman, the family invites a ritual
master to conduct rituals. The Thai apply sesame paste to the
stomachs of pregnant women. Traditionally the Hmong bury the
placenta at the foot of the principal column in the house. The Ede
place the placenta in a calabash that is then buried at the edge
of a spring. Other populations hang the placenta in a forest tree.

ses sentiments et ses émotions juste avant le retour de son fiancé, après 6 ans de séparation. Les dernières lignes de ce journal
sont écrites par le fiancé qui exprime, à son tour, ses sentiments après avoir lu ce qu'elle avait noté à son sujet.

of the war. “On the 18th of October 1968, after a sustained gunfire attack, the enemy attacked suddenly again. ljust let the
fire in the kitchen go out,
column2: did not have the time to look for my purse, the jet plane was behind me. With my comrades I left

column1: for the front. When we came back, the huts and the trenches had disappeared, gun fire stopped in the middle of the trench.”
The notebook ended on February 1st 1971, a few months before Xung s wedding. She wrote of her feelings and emotions just
before the return of her fiancé after six years of separation. The last lines of this diary were written by the fiancé, expressing his
feelings after he had read what she had written about him.

Squad 4, Company 552 of the Young Volunteers in Ha Tinh was
founded on 26 February, 1967 with 16 girls between the ages of 17 and
24 led by Vo Thi Tan. They were responsible for filling bomb craters at
Dong Loc T-Junction, to ensure access for the trucks moving from the
rear to the front line. After the 18th bombardment by the American
enemy, 10 girls were killed instantly on July 24th, 1968. The squad was
given a posthumous award ‘Hero of the Popular Armed Forces’ on 7

L’escouade n°4 de Ha Tinh, 16 filles volontaires de 17 à 24 ans, créée le 26
février 1967, est chargée de réparer les routes au carrefour de Dong Lôc
après les bombardements et d'assurer le flux des camions vers le front. Le
24juillet 1968, dix d'entre elles, dont leur chef Vo Thi Tân, sont tuées sous
le 18ème bombardement de la journée. L'équipe reçoit le titre posthume
de «Héros des Forces armées populaires » le 7 Juin 1972.

; yet once lost, one immediately suffocates and struggles in agony.
The freedom and democracy we now take for granted did not come out of thin air. Taiwan’s path to freedom has been a democratic struggle spanning
several generations, regardless of provincial background or ethnic group. It was built through
countless waves of intense and relentless clashes and resistance against authoritarian regimes—a process that spanned several generations, transcending provincial and ethnic boundaries!
In the 1990s, Taiwan completed its democratization process, including a full legislative election and direct presidential elections. Furthermore, after nine
alternations of power between political parties. In the 2021 “Freedom House” freedom index, Taiwan ranked second in Asia:
In February 2022, the Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU) released the “2021 Democracy Index.” Taiwan
BARBS » became the only democratic country in Asia to rank among the top 10.
Only by understanding the past can we comprehend the present and look toward the future. The exhibition is organized within a historical context. Beginning in 1945
and continuing to the present, it centers on the evolution of freedom of speech in Taiwan, using authentic, original historical materials to trace this journey
journey from the darkness of human rights violations to freedom and democracy

The ‘comfort women’ for the Japanese military refers to women who were forced to live as sex slaves at
‘comfort station’ established. The ‘comfort stations’, which began in Shanghai in 1932, increased rapidly
after the Sino-Japanese War in 1937, and expanded to almost all Japanese army posts as the occupied
areas expanded. The number of victims 15 estimated to be up to 300,000.
The ‘comfort women’ was not appropriate for expressing the essence of the problem, but it was
established as a historical term in that it was officially used by the Japanese at the time. In English, ‘Sex
Slaves for the Japanese military is used to reflect the essential meaning.

Gunkanzima as Seen Through the Poet’s Eyes _ .
Hashima,"" better known to us as ""Gunkanjima,"" experienced significant growth in the late 19th century centered on the Mitsubishi
Group’s coal mining industry, but it was notorious for its oppressive labor
management practices. In particular, during the 1940s, countless Koreans
who were forcibly mobilized suffered from abuse and industrial accidents. The artist expressed the pain of Gunkanjima
through FS lines and monochromatic tones.

accordance with the Temporarily Enacted Act on Compensation for Civil Claims to Japan after 1975. The issue of anti-
humane forced mobilization victims, such as the Japanese military ‘comfort women’ was not properly addressed during
the Korea-Japan talks.

Koreans who were forcibly mobilized alongside him. Third, this is a “roster” donated by Cheon Jong-min, who was forcibly mobilized to the Kawanami (1110) Industrial Co., Ltd. shipyard in Koyagishima (Jom #@t), Nagasaki (Ton 1) Prefecture, and later dispatched to the Blow)

This exhibition was specially curated to honor the victims of forced mobilization under Japanese colonial rule, ensure that this painful history is not forgotten,
and enable the public to widely commemorate them.
Featuring 60 calligraphy works that reimagine the vivid testimonies of victims forcibly mobilized during the Japanese colonial era
and poets’ memorial writings,
at the Berne History Museum. We hope this will be a meaningful opportunity for you to empathize with
and remember the hardships and pain of that era.
Hosted by the Foundation for Support of Victims of Japanese Forced Mobilization
column2: Co-organized by SEUSS, Gulsimun Culture Development Center Gula
